title: Creatio Expands Support for Enterprise AI Adoption in LATAM with AI Launchpad Program
summary: New program offers local AI consulting, AI workflow development tooling, and AI credits at no charge to help businesses move from AI plans to production
body_markdown:
Creatio, an AI CRM and workflow platform where people and AI agents work together, today announced its[AI Launchpad LATAM Program](https://www.creatio.com/page/creatio-ai-launchpad-latam-program) , an initiative designed to help businesses across Latin America (LATAM) develop and deploy AI agents and agentic workflows. The program combines complimentary AI consulting, workflow development and deployment tools, and an allocation of AI credits for testing and production use. Applications for the program are now being accepted through January 29, 2027.


The program builds on findings from[Creatio’s State of Enterprise AI Adoption Report: LATAM Edition](https://www.creatio.com/page/the-state-of-enterprise-ai-adoption-LATAM-edition) and reflects the company’s recognition that businesses need practical support to scale AI with confidence. While 81% of surveyed organizations reported already scaling AI agents across departments or expecting to do so within 12 months, only 23% of decision-makers felt very confident about scaling AI. Creatio is pairing those findings with hands-on implementation support to help businesses identify valuable AI use cases and deploy them into production.


“AI agents will reshape how enterprises across Latin America operate and compete,” said Agustin Alaman, VP of Sales at Creatio. “Our role is to help our customers turn that opportunity into progress in their businesses. With our AI Launchpad Program, we’re committing expertise and resources to help them build the experience, confidence and capabilities that broader adoption demands.”


As part of the program, accepted participants will work with a local AI consultant to identify agentic workflows based on their potential business value. Those workflows will then be designed, built, tested and deployed into production using Creatio AI Studio and/or AI CRM, with an allocation of AI credits to support testing and production use.


Businesses across Latin America are welcome to apply at[https://www.creatio.com/page/creatio-ai-launchpad-latam-program](https://www.creatio.com/page/creatio-ai-launchpad-latam-program) through January 29, 2027, with priority given to existing Creatio customers and enterprise organizations looking to advance their business with AI. Applicants will receive a response within five business days. Participation is subject to application review and program availability, and accepted participants should be prepared to dedicate time to planning and implementation.


*Details of the included development and deployment services, AI credit allocation and validity, and participation requirements will be discussed with applicants during the review process.*


**About Creatio**


Creatio is an AI CRM and workflow platform where people and AI agents work together — with no limits on users, agents, or scale. We help midsize and large organizations run customer workflows in the AI era. Headquartered in Boston, MA, with a global team and a large ecosystem of partners, Creatio serves thousands of customers in over 100 countries and automates tens of millions of workflows daily. Genuine care for our clients and partners is at the heart of our DNA.
